title: SEEN_DIGESTS grows without bound in memory
description: inbox.rs:20-21. The SEEN_DIGESTS HashMap is only purged inside verify_and_fetch_actor when a new request arrives. If traffic stops, stale entries remain forever. More critically, if all requests pass the cached-key fast path (line 582-584), the replay-protection block (lines 602-616) runs and inserts entries, but purging only happens in that same block — so entries accumulate proportional to total requests over REPLAY_WINDOW_MS. Under sustained load this is a memory leak bounded only by request rate. The retain() call on line 611 runs per-request inside the lock, making it O(n) per request where n is the map size.
